subject: Sky Score news: December 2026
heading: What's new this month
intro: Three changes to the data since last month.

items.title: Planes overhead now runs to September 2026
items.body: The counts of planes passing over each postcode now cover January to September 2026, at nine airports.
items.label: See the planes over your area

items.title: House prices updated to September 2026
items.body: Every UK council area's prices and price trend now use the UK House Price Index for September.
items.label: Browse council areas

items.title: Measured air quality beside the model
items.body: A postcode's answer now shows the nearest air-quality monitor within 5 km, measured, beside DEFRA's modelled figure for its square.
items.label: Open the full map
